headline.purpose: The one page heading: the name on Home, the project title on a case study, the message on the 404 page.

title.purpose: Section headings and the project name in the work list.

code.purpose: Inline code in case study prose only. Breaks anywhere to stop overflow.

motion.name: link-underline
motion.purpose: The only motion. The link underline thickens from 1px to 2px and turns ink on hover and focus. Reduced motion sets every transition to 0.01ms.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Top page padding grows from 64px to 96px. The column does not change.

components.name: Text Link
components.description: The only interactive element. Text colour, thin graphite underline that thickens on hover and focus.
components.html: Read the Habi case study.
components.css: .ds-body { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--text, #1c1c1a); background: var(--surface, #fbfbfa); margin: 0; padding: 16px; } .ds-link { color: inherit; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-decoration-color: var(--text-muted, #63635e); text-underline-offset: 0.22em; transition: text-decoration-thickness 150ms ease-out, text-decoration-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-link:hover, .ds-link:focus-visible { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-decoration-color: var(--text, #1c1c1a); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1c1c1a); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-link { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

narrative.overview:
The site is one narrow column of plain text and links, read top to bottom. The owner pinned the category standard (text-first, single column, like leerob.com) as a deliberate choice. The interface recedes so the work and the writing lead. There is no hero, no card, no button and no decoration.

Rank comes from space and weight, not from size. The type hierarchy is flat on purpose: body and section headings share one size, and the page heading is one step larger. The light and dark grounds follow the reader's system setting. The only motion is the link underline, which thickens on hover and focus.
keyCharacteristics: One left-aligned column, 36rem wide, centred in the viewport.
Monochrome: one ground, one text colour, one grey.
System sans only, regular and medium weights.
Links in text colour with a thin underline.
No borders, cards, shadows, gradients or icons in the interface.

rules.name: The Three Values Rule
rules.body: Each scheme uses exactly three colours: paper, ink and graphite. A new surface adds no accent, tint or second grey.

rules.name: The System Ground Rule
rules.body: The reader's system setting picks light or dark. The site has no theme toggle.

rules.name: The Flat Ramp Rule
rules.body: Body and section headings share 16px; the page heading is 18px. Weight (500) and the space above a heading carry rank. Do not add a larger display size.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Use regular (400) and medium (500) only. Bold text in prose renders at 500.

rules.name: The Space Carries Rank Rule
rules.body: Separate sections with space, never with rules, borders or background bands.

dos: **Do** keep every page in the one 36rem column.
**Do** use ink for text and links, and graphite for secondary text only.
**Do** mark rank with weight 500 and space above the heading (56px between Home sections).
**Do** keep the link underline as the only motion, and remove it under reduced motion.
**Do** label any raster that shows sample data in its caption.
donts: **Don't** add a hero banner, project cards, buttons or decoration.
**Don't** add borders, shadows, gradients or icons to the interface.
**Don't** add a colour accent or a third weight.
**Don't** add a theme toggle; the system setting decides.
